answer: Proof-of-work alone invites Sybil wallets, so this economy charges collateral instead. Each identity posts a bonded deposit sized to its recent mining rate, and rewards unlock only after a delay. Flooding with ten thousand fresh wallets therefore means locking real capital in every one of them simultaneously. A single cheap identity still earns, but a swarm cannot: the attacker's cost multiplies per account while each payout stays flat. Duplicate answers trigger a matching echo across wallets, and both deposits burn. Honest miners see this as a meadow after dawn, quiet and affordable.
